page.overview:
Who is Soha Sirrendrin?

Soha Sirrendrin was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in in Arrakeen. They asked if he ran a CHOAM vendor and he replied that he did before asking if it was a test by the Committee on Interstellar Traffic and Trade or if Lady Nevaldine had put them up to it. They replied that it was not a test and he assured them that everything was in order. He told them that CHOAM's technology was the key to mastering their environment and explained how their various products worked.
